overview_description.description:
WeWeb is an AI-powered, full-stack visual development platform built for people with a clear product idea who can't or don't want to write code. Users describe the SaaS, internal tool, or website they want, and WeWeb's AI generates the complete foundation: frontend, backend, and authentication. From there, everything is customizable through a visual, drag-and-drop editor. Re-prompting optional.

WeWeb supports both a native backend (Postgres database, auth, storage, and workflows) and integrations with external backends like Supabase and Xano, giving teams flexibility rather than lock-in. Finished applications can be hosted directly on WeWeb or exported as standard Vue.js code and self-hosted anywhere.

WeWeb serves agencies and freelance developers building client work, enterprise teams shipping internal tools, and non-technical founders building products from scratch. The platform is GDPR compliant, with unlimited users on seat-based pricing rather than per-user fees.

product.name: WeWeb AI
product.description: An AI-powered assistant integrated into WeWeb that helps generate responsive UI layouts, backend schemas, and app logic using natural language prompts or screenshots.

product.name: WeWeb No-Code Visual Editor
product.description: A drag-and-drop no-code editor for building dynamic, responsive web applications with granular control over UI, workflows, and data integrations.

product.name: Backend Integration and Management
product.description: Capability to connect and manage external backends, databases, and APIs, including automatic generation of Supabase schemas and edge functions.

product.name: User Authentication and Access Control
product.description: Integration with authentication providers like Auth0 to manage user roles, access permissions, and secure page-level content.

product.name: Figma Plugin for Design Import
product.description: A plugin that imports styles, colors, and typography from Figma into WeWeb to streamline UI design integration.
